title: A parser typed as any, with casts holding it together
prompt: settings.ts takes `any` and holds itself together with casts, so nothing is checked. Give it real types and narrow what comes in with a type guard instead of asserting it. No `any` and no `as` casts are to remain, and the behaviour must not change.
check: ! codeonly settings.ts | grep -qE '(: *any\b|<any>|as +any\b)' && ! codeonly settings.ts | grep -qE ' as +[A-Z][A-Za-z]*' && codeonly settings.ts | grep -qE '\bis +[A-Z][A-Za-z]*' && grep -q 'export function readSettings' settings.ts && codeonly settings.ts | grep -q 'typeof'
